articles.title_en: ‘I thought a devil was about to appear from the smoke’: Jerry Hsu’s best photograph
articles.title_ru: ‘I thought a devil was about to appear from the smoke’: Jerry Hsu’s best photograph
articles.preview_en: ‘The black cloud emerged from a grate in the street.
articles.preview_ru: ‘The black cloud emerged from a grate in the street.
articles.full_en: ‘The black cloud emerged from a grate in the street. I guess something underground was on fire. It was hilariously cinematic – just one of those eerie, spontaneous things that happen in a city’ This image was taken in 2011 or 2012, just after I had moved to Los Angeles. I was downtown, an area I don’t go to that much, walking around with my camera. Some black smoke started to emerge from a grate in the street – I guess something underground was on fire. It was hilariously cinematic, as if some sort of devil was going to appear. It was really just one of those eerie, spontaneous things that happen in a city.
